news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis said it will report summarized Q2 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open on August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call and webcast at 9:00 am ET to review results and provide a business update.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Second-Quarter 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis' board declared its Q2 2026 dividend on Series B Preferred Stock payable entirely in roughly 80,463 shares of common stock (rather than cash) on July 29, 2026, to holders of record as of July 21, 2026, conserving cash while modestly diluting common shareholders.

news.headline: NeurAxis Stockholders Approve Director Slate and Equity Compensation Plans at 2026 Annual Meeting
news.summary: At its June 10, 2026 annual meeting, NeurAxis stockholders re-elected all six director nominees (including CEO Brian Carrico) and approved an amendment to the company's Omnibus Incentive Plan along with a new 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings and business update call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will release Q2 2026 financial results before market open and hold a conference call at 9:00 am ET, its next major checkpoint on revenue growth, margins, and cash burn following Q1's 80% YoY revenue growth.

catalysts.label: Further payer medical-policy coverage wins
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis has a recurring cadence of announcing new commercial and Medicaid payer coverage decisions for IB-Stim/PENFS; additional insurer policies are expected to keep expanding the roughly 51-55 million already-covered lives.

catalysts.label: Progress toward cash-flow breakeven
catalysts.detail: Management has guided toward reaching cash-flow breakeven during 2026, helped by the new AMA Category I CPT code (effective January 2026) that broadens reimbursement; upcoming quarterly reports will show whether the company is tracking to that goal.

catalysts.label: Randomized controlled trial readout (Cleveland Clinic/Stanford)
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is running a randomized, double-blind study of PENFS therapy at Cleveland Clinic and Stanford University in adult patients; management has indicated usable data could be available in roughly one to two years, which could support expansion into adult indications.

pulse: NeurAxis remains a small, revenue-ramping medtech commercializing its IB-Stim (PENFS) neuromodulation device for pediatric functional abdominal pain, with growth accelerating after its new AMA Category I CPT code took effect in January 2026 and payer coverage expanded to roughly 51-55 million lives. Q1 2026 revenue grew 80% year-over-year to $1.6 million with 86.4% gross margin, and the next checkpoint is the Q2 2026 results/business update call on August 11, 2026. News flow over the past ~45 days has been light and largely administrative (a Series B preferred stock dividend paid in shares, and routine annual-meeting governance approvals), with the market's attention now turning to whether Q2 sustains the growth and margin trajectory seen in Q1.
